question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a silver present, Bob has a blue present, Claire has a black present, Dave has a green present, Eve has a brown present, Fred has a yellow present, and Gertrude has a teal present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Bob and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Eve swap their gifts. Finally, Gertrude and Dave swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Fred has the
Options:
(A) silver present
(B) blue present
(C) black present
(D) green present
(E) brown present
(F) yellow present
(G) teal present
solution:
Present colors in holder order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: silver, blue, black, green, brown, yellow, teal
1. Bob ↔ Fred: silver, yellow, black, green, brown, blue, teal
2. Dave ↔ Alice: green, yellow, black, silver, brown, blue, teal
3. Bob ↔ Dave: green, silver, black, yellow, brown, blue, teal
4. Eve ↔ Alice: brown, silver, black, yellow, green, blue, teal
5. Eve ↔ Dave: brown, silver, black, green, yellow, blue, teal
6. Dave ↔ Eve: brown, silver, black, yellow, green, blue, teal
7. Gertrude ↔ Dave: brown, silver, black, teal, green, blue, yellow
Fred has the blue present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
